Since the ability to change maxSwapThreshold is controlled by the owner, this creates a scenario where the owner can restrict trading for all users, thus implementing a LIMIT behavior.

The function 'Ownable.renounceOwnership()' allows the owner to renounce ownership, which means they can no longer control the contract. However, before renouncing, the owner can set 'maxSwapThreshold' in 'DiabloElon.setSwapBackSettings(bool,uint256,uint256)'.

The '_transfer' function checks if 'contractTokenBalance > maxSwapThreshold'. If the owner sets 'maxSwapThreshold' to a value that prevents normal users from transferring tokens (e.g., setting it very high), they can effectively limit the ability of users to execute transfers.

This means that the owner has the power to control the transfer process by adjusting 'maxSwapThreshold', which directly impacts whether transfers can occur or not, thus classifying this behavior as LIMIT.
